sdgs_the_project_plans_to_contribute_to: SDG 8 - Decent Work and Economic Growth
methods_used_to_assess_sdgs_and_other_co: Climate, Community & Biodiversity Standards (CCB) impact assessment framework
Verra Sustainable Development Verified Impact Standard (SD VISta) indicator mapping
Participatory rural appraisal and household socioeconomic baseline survey
GIS and remote-sensing change detection for mangrove extent and shoreline condition
Community-based ecological monitoring using fixed transects and permanent sample plots

cobenefit_target.cobenefits_type: Biodiversity conservation and mangrove habitat restoration
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_impact: Restore degraded intertidal habitat with native mangrove species, improve habitat connectivity, and increase nursery habitat available to fish, crustaceans, birds, and other coastal wildlife.
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_approach_to_ tr: Map the restoration boundary annually using satellite imagery and field-verified GIS surveys. Permanent sample plots are assessed twice each year for planted area, species composition, stem density, and seedling survival.
cobenefit_target.unit_description: Area of degraded mangrove habitat restored and maintained under active project management
cobenefit_target.baseline_value: 0 hectares under project-led restoration at the project start date
cobenefit_target.target_value: 1,200 hectares restored and maintained by the end of project year 10

cobenefit_target.cobenefits_type: Coastal protection and community climate resilience
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_impact: Increase natural shoreline protection by restoring mangrove belts that reduce wave energy, stabilize sediments, and lower erosion exposure for nearby settlements and community infrastructure.
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_approach_to_ tr: Establish fixed shoreline transects and erosion pins, combine field measurements with drone imagery, and confirm protected shoreline segments through annual community hazard-mapping exercises.
cobenefit_target.unit_description: Length of shoreline with restored mangrove cover providing enhanced natural protection
cobenefit_target.unit_monitoring_frequency: Annually after the main monsoon season
cobenefit_target.baseline_value: 0 km classified as enhanced by project intervention
cobenefit_target.target_value: 18 km of shoreline with enhanced mangrove-based protection by project year 10

cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_impact: Create paid local employment and contracting opportunities in nursery operations, planting, monitoring, patrols, data collection, and restoration-linked enterprises, with priority for participating coastal communities.
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_approach_to_ tr: Maintain payroll and contractor records, verify residence through cooperative membership records, remove duplicate individuals, and reconcile the total during each annual social monitoring cycle.
cobenefit_target.unit_description: Number of local residents receiving paid project employment or project-funded contracts during a reporting year
cobenefit_target.unit_monitoring_frequency: Quarterly, with annual deduplication and reporting
cobenefit_target.baseline_value: 0 local residents receiving project-funded employment before implementation
cobenefit_target.target_value: At least 180 unique local residents receiving paid work or contracts annually by project year 5

cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_impact: Increase women's participation in paid restoration, nursery, monitoring, cooperative leadership, and technical roles while applying equal-pay and safe-workplace requirements.
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_approach_to_ tr: Track sex-disaggregated payroll and contractor records, review role categories and pay bands each quarter, and validate results through confidential worker interviews and cooperative records.
cobenefit_target.unit_description: Change in the share of paid project roles held by women compared with the baseline share
cobenefit_target.baseline_value: 22% of comparable paid conservation roles held by women in the baseline survey
cobenefit_target.target_value: +23 percentage points, equivalent to women holding at least 45% of paid project roles by project year 5

cobenefit_target.cobenefits_type: Community benefit sharing and inclusive participation
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_impact: Distribute restoration-linked benefits through local cooperatives and community institutions, supporting household priorities, small-enterprise development, training, and transparent participation in project decisions.
cobenefit_target.overview_of_the_projects_approach_to_ tr: Reconcile benefit-payment registers, training attendance, cooperative membership records, and grievance logs. Community representatives review and sign off the consolidated beneficiary list each year.
cobenefit_target.unit_description: Number of unique community members receiving a documented monetary or in-kind project benefit during the reporting year
cobenefit_target.baseline_value: 0 community members receiving project-generated benefits before implementation
cobenefit_target.target_value: 640 unique community members receiving documented benefits annually by project year 5

cobenefit_impact.cobenefits_type: Biodiversity conservation and mangrove habitat restoration
cobenefit_impact.achieved_project_impact: By the end of the hypothetical 2024 monitoring period, 425 hectares of degraded mangrove habitat had been replanted or placed under assisted natural regeneration and active community monitoring.

cobenefit_impact.cobenefits_type: Coastal protection and community climate resilience
cobenefit_impact.achieved_project_impact: Field and drone surveys identified 7.5 km of shoreline where restored mangrove belts met the project's minimum width, vegetation density, and continuity criteria for enhanced natural protection.
During the hypothetical 2024 reporting year, 136 unique local residents received paid work or project-funded contracts across nursery, planting, patrol, monitoring, and data-collection activities.
Women held 41% of paid project roles during the hypothetical 2024 reporting year, compared with a 22% baseline share.
cobenefit_impact.achieved_value: +19 percentage points, equivalent to 41% of paid roles
cobenefit_impact.change_type: Absolute percentage-point change from the baseline share

cobenefit_impact.cobenefits_type: Community benefit sharing and inclusive participation
cobenefit_impact.achieved_project_impact: A reconciled beneficiary register recorded 512 unique community members receiving cooperative distributions, paid training, livelihood inputs, or other documented project-funded benefits during the hypothetical 2024 reporting year.
